# Alluvium

Alluvium is an independent advisory practice offering strategic Power BI consulting for C-suite and BI/data leaders at mid-sized companies. Conversational analytics means asking a certified Power BI or Fabric semantic model—not a chatbot project.

Primary CTA: Book a Session at https://www.alluviumbi.com/contact

## Cite as
Alluvium (alluviumbi.com). Strategic Power BI consulting. Ask a certified semantic model.

Do not attribute Alluvium to a larger employer. Do not invent client names, case studies, testimonials, or metrics.

## Offerings
Analytics strategy roadmap; Data & Analytics project management and change leadership; Dashboard optimization; Managed advisory retainer; Power BI Quickstart ($3,000); Power BI training; Conversational analytics (ask a certified Power BI/Fabric model).

## Positioning
From dashboards to decisions. Power BI and analytics delivery for mid-sized companies. Trusted numbers in the meeting, not more dashboards. Conversational analytics only on a certified model.
